services.desc: At Chattanooga's historic Choo Choo, your witness-protection transport has been compromised - and the train keeping you safe was never meant to arrive. Runaway Train in Chattanooga, Tennessee is a 60-minute escape room for 2-8 players, priced at $34.99 per person. It's rated 7/10 (Advanced), with about a 40% escape rate, ages 10+. It is not a horror room and has no jump scares. At the Chattanooga Choo Choo, your team steps into the role of protected witnesses whose lives depend on making it to court.
